text:
Type: cloud-shaped wall night light
Use: soft night light or decoration on a wall; children's room, nursery, bedroom
Style: contemporary, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: white opal plastic shade, white cord with inline switch
Colors: white, soft white glow
Shape: flat puffy cloud outline with rounded scalloped edges, hangs flat against the wall with a dangling cord, light, playful silhouette
Feel: dreamy, gentle, playful, calm
Goes with: pastel walls, white furniture, soft textiles; children's rooms, nurseries, Scandinavian bedrooms
